---
name: Close Savings Account
description: >
  Permanently close a savings account. Activate when the customer asks to close
  or cancel a savings account (not a credit card, charge dispute, or fraud
  report).
complete_when:
  condition: session.close_savings_account.account_closed
tool_constraints:
- close_savings_account:
    requires: >
      session.close_savings_account.account_name
      and session.close_savings_account.close_reason
      and not session.close_savings_account.account_closed
    requires_confirmation:
      enabled: true
      utter_for_confirmation: utter_ask_close_confirmation
      utter_on_user_denial: utter_close_cancelled
    on_success: utter_account_closed
    on_failure: utter_account_close_failed
utter:
- utter_recording_notice:
    on: activate
- utter_early_withdrawal_warning:
    when: session.close_savings_account.close_reason == "early_withdrawal"
---
Activate @block.main immediately. Do not collect account details in free-form
prose or call `close_savings_account` yourself — the ordered block collects
fields and runs `execute_tool`.

Do **not** ask the customer to confirm before the execute step — the engine
pauses on `requires_confirmation`. Resume only via `resolve_tool_confirmation`
(do not re-call `close_savings_account` while confirmation is pending).

Do not claim the account is closed until `close_savings_account` has run and
`account_closed` is true. After a successful close, call `complete` if
the skill is still active.

If the close tool fails, tell the customer using the failure outcome. If the
customer declines confirmation, the engine emits the denial line — do not invent
cancel wording or retry the close unless they explicitly ask again.

:::ordered_block id=main
steps:
- id: collect_account_name
  collect: account_name
  utterance: utter_ask_account_name
  description: Name of the savings account to close.
  next: collect_close_reason
- id: collect_close_reason
  collect: close_reason
  utterance: utter_ask_close_reason
  description: >
    Why the customer is closing — consolidating, relocating, or
    early_withdrawal.
  next: close_account
- id: close_account
  execute_tool: close_savings_account
  next: END
- id: END
:::
